messages:
maria: Heads up — scheduled maintenance tonight 02:00 UTC. We'll pin runtime v3.2.1 on dedicated clusters and enable fallback routing during the rollout. Need final statuspage copy + customer email. Who owns the comms?

kevin: I can take the first draft. Quick Q: are we surfacing SLA impact? We expect short cache-warmup latency (a few 100ms) and maybe transient 5xxs during first 10m if canaries fail.

tony: Oncall will monitor. Rollback criteria: error rate >2% sustained for 5m or latency p50 >2s for 10m -> immediate rollback. Keep a 30m rollback window. I'll post canary dashboards.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: pin runtime v3.2.1 -> dedicated-prod at 2026-03-21T02:00Z. Canary lanes: cpu/gpu-canary-1, cpu-canary-2. Auto-fallback enabled to v3.1.9 if health-check fails.

sarah: Drafting status page and email. Proposed statuspage snippet below. Please review short copy only (we'll expand KB link).

sarah: ```Planned maintenance: runtime version pinning

Start: 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC
Estimated duration: 30 minutes
Impact: Possible brief latency increases and transient errors for some dedicated customers while caches warm. No data loss expected.
What we're doing: pinning runtime to v3.2.1 and enabling fallback routing to preserve availability.
````

maria: LGTM. Add a line telling Dedicated customers they can request a deferral via their CSM if this window conflicts. Also include link to KB: https://kb.redwood.ai/runtime-version-pinning

kevin: Also add rollback note for transparency: "If instability is detected, we'll revert to v3.1.9 and notify affected customers."

sarah: Good call. Updated copy and created status update. Scheduling customer email to go out 30 minutes before window. Draft email below (short, actionable):

sarah: ```Subject: Upcoming maintenance (runtime pinning) — 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC
Hi there,
We have a planned maintenance window to pin the inference runtime to v3.2.1 for Dedicated clusters. This helps stabilize performance and enable new routing rules.
When: 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC (30 minutes)
Impact: You may see brief latency increases or transient errors for up to ~10 minutes as caches warm. No data loss expected.
If this window won't work for you, reply to this email or contact your CSM to request a deferral.
Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

status-bot: status-bot: scheduled status update created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PR-4512 (publishing at 2026-03-21T01:30Z)

tony: I'll be on watch and will post canary metrics at t+5m. @maria ping me 5m before start so I can join the thread.

maria: Thanks all — sending to ops channel for final signoff, and scheduling email. Will update here when posted. :thumbsup:
